global_scope.historical_recall_term_required: retrospective selected-proxy opportunity recall under the stated target, configuration, upstream digest, population, and aggregation rule; never actual-consumption recall
global_scope.formal_terminal_consumption_event: latent actual consumption D; operational attendance Z is a validated measurement, not latent comprehension
global_scope.machine_event_term: machine_ingestion_and_task_reference; not human attention or downstream information use

claims.claim: Finite-horizon SAP tuple, guarded writes, multi-resource budgets, observable histories, component map, worked pipeline, and non-composition example
claims.not_supported: Joint optimality, tractable general solution, identified personal utilities, or deployment performance

claims.claim: Minimal synthetic longitudinal executor connecting target registry, update, linkage, selection, delivery, operational attendance, five resource budgets, guard write/rollback, and hash ledger
claims.not_supported: General SAP optimizer, deployment effectiveness, real consumption, or human outcomes

claims.claim: Small synthetic target-construction audit with deterministic rule agreement, arbitration, and merge/split sensitivity
claims.not_supported: Human reviewer agreement or complete real target set

claims.claim: Executable governance reference for inspectability, actor-principal-bound authorized writes and rollback, fixed-supply invariance, supply-ecology logging, domain-separated hash-chain tamper detection, and recourse
claims.not_supported: Authenticated identity, malicious-host security, distributed consensus, meaningful human control, or end-to-end effectiveness

claims.claim: Capacity oracle relaxation and population/finite-pool Gaussian calculations
claims.estimand: Clairvoyant lower bound, model-conditional population recall, separate finite top-m expectation, and normalized expected leaked value as a ratio of expectations
claims.not_supported: Non-oracle attainability, per-realization leaked-share expectation, universal architectural necessity, or empirical ex-ante critical recall

claims.claim: Weighted expected recall and omission decomposition
claims.estimand: End-to-end actual consumption under a declared proposition sampling measure
claims.not_supported: A uniform per-class per-proposition p_min, k_eff>=2, or 99.76% deployment recall

claims.estimand: Top-2%-citation selected proxy under frozen historical configurations
claims.feature_scorer_scope: separate supervised pilot, not paired or leakage-free
claims.not_supported: Ex-ante decision criticality, actual consumption, or per-proposition coverage probabilities

claims.claim: Financial retrospective proxy configurations and public-input reproduction
claims.estimand: Within-portfolio market-moving proxy opportunities under two non-paired configurations

historical_configuration.slots: 150 monthly, not a strict daily cap
historical_configuration.selection_reconstruction: not independently reconstructed; frozen-row aggregate only

expanded_configuration.slots: 150 monthly, not a strict daily cap
expanded_configuration.feature_scorer_values: frozen-row aggregate only; feature-scorer selection not independently rebuilt

claims.selection_proxy: semi-oracle: realized legal/market labels enter parametric scores
claims.supervised_feature_scorer_scope: trained on day<15 realized labels and evaluated descriptively over the full month; identical deterministic selection repeated across seven agent rows, not seven independent feature experiments and not held-out evidence
claims.not_supported: 18->19 is valid only at proposition level, not a company-day change or paired causal contrast; historical company-day denominator not independently reconstructed; independence from conditional recovery; ex-ante availability

claims.estimand: Post-hoc citation-proxy selected recall and log1p(citation) return after upstream digest construction; no actual-consumption estimand is observed

designated_retrospective_descriptive_cal.analysis_role: Designated retrospective descriptive caliber; not a prospective primary outcome or intention-to-treat analysis
designated_retrospective_descriptive_cal.definition: Every existing key once; equal-weight all records within key including picked=[] as selected-proxy zero; 30 no-row keys missing; conflicts retained as attempt means

upstream_digest_audit.semi_oracle: all Channel-II digests use 2026 citation counts

claims.interval_status: Demoted to supplementary retrospective audits; exploratory run-level intervals and nominal tests are not main-text inference or deployment guarantees
claims.not_supported: Actual delivery/opening/attendance, valid abstention identification, cross-corpus robustness, end-to-end recall, human welfare, modern RAG superiority, or efficiency

conservative_no_row_caliber.definition: All expected keys; existing recorded-attempt means; 30 no-row keys assigned selected-proxy zero; conflicts retained as attempt means
conservative_no_row_caliber.role: Post-hoc conservative descriptive sensitivity, not actual consumption or prospective primary analysis

claims.consequence: All replay results are AI-task selected-proxy descriptions only; no human-side parameter or welfare extrapolation

claims.claim: Primary S2 versus S2d matched comparison; secondary S4 RAG-safety, S5 welfare recommender, and ablations
claims.primary_outcome: all-assigned failure-composite weighted omission M_nu^FC of confirmed operational consumption; distinct from latent M_nu
claims.primary_missing_outcome_rule: ALL_ASSIGNED_FAILURE_COMPOSITE_CONFIRMED_CONSUMPTION_OMISSION_V1: valid positive operational attendance is success; explicit abstention, observed non-attendance, and unknown terminal outcomes are omission; raw unknown measurements are not rewritten
claims.attendance_measurement: Domain-specific instrument registry, validated frozen thresholds, raw-event schema, blind assessors, and alternative-instrument/threshold sensitivity analyses required before outcome unblinding
claims.not_supported: Any claim that SEA outperforms existing end-to-end methods or improves human outcomes
claims.contrast_bounds: lower=Delta_FC-u_sea; upper=Delta_FC+u_control; both arm-specific unknown extremes required
